About

My background spans embedded electronics, firmware and hardware design, with industry research in sensing, instrumentation and renewable-energy telemetry. Earlier manufacturing, CAD/design and construction work informs how I approach assembly, documentation and hardware integration.

I graduated from Conestoga College in August 2026 with a Bachelor of Applied Engineering in Electronic Systems Engineering.

Design, implementation and validation

Featured Projects

Capstone / Distributed Embedded System

2026

Smart Distributed Acoustic Calibration System

A distributed acoustic measurement and analysis platform connecting ESP32-S3 sensor nodes to a Raspberry Pi/Linux backend. I developed node firmware for audio acquisition, signal processing and MQTT telemetry, and contributed to backend integration and validation.

Embedded Hardware / PCB Design

2024

Nerf Battle Bot Mobile Robot Platform

A mobile robot platform combining custom PCB design, embedded motor control and Raspberry Pi communication. I designed and assembled boards in Altium Designer, investigated power and interface faults during bring-up, and developed C firmware for motor control and RS232/UART integration.

More engineering work

Multi-Processor Embedded Control System · 2025

Steam Punk Elevator Project VI

A multi-processor elevator control project integrating STM32, Raspberry Pi, Arduino and motor-controller hardware through CAN. I developed STM32 control firmware, debugged faults across embedded, Linux and UI layers, and tested emergency-call, floor-selection and input-lockout behaviour.
